implementation: Separate scalar targets, context189, fixed RBF64 and finite-pair risk/log1p-margin; Torch float64 margin-adjusted CE/autograd/full253x253 Hessian on all2598 rows. Runtime uses original valid candidates and unadjusted scores.
CE_definition: CE is margin-adjusted training CE. unadjusted_CE omits margins; both are calculated for both old/new weights. No comparison between different objective definitions.
comparison: Immediately preceding risk189 weights padded with64 zeros versus current253 weights on identical targets, original context, and the same margin objective. Old certificate is checked against its native189 gradient, not the expanded253 gradient. TRAIN-only description, no tuning or model selection.
caveat: Reference-safe training targets do not enforce reference-safe inference. Violation rates are measured from unrestricted original-valid runtime choices; no runtime GT mask is used.
